- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The GR-90 is recommended as one of the best hiking trails with breathtaking views, running approximately 36 kilometers and taking two to three days to complete.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Highlights of the GR-90 trail include reaching the summit of Moncayo mountain and experiencing the Fuenfría waterfall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ideal time to visit for hiking is during spring and autumn, with spring offering blooming wildflowers and autumn showcasing vibrant forest colors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Summer hiking can be challenging due to high temperatures, and winter may not be suitable for hiking but offers skiing activities.
